st: Everybody Hates a Part Time Job
d: Chris learns the value of a dollar when he needs to make some money to buy a leather jacket so he can look "cool
Julius and Rochelle can't afford to buy Chris a Christmas gift after the water heater breaks..
Chris tries to find outfits for his school picture that will make him look cool.
Love is in the air on Valentine's Day when Chris develops a "bus crush" on a girl he regularly sees on his route home.
Chris is forced to defend his title as neighborhood "Asteroids” champ
Chris tries everything to hide an "F" on his report card from his parents.
When Rochelle's father dies unexpectedly, instead of grieving, she acts as if nothing's wrong.
Sick of being second best to his little brother, Chris decides to enroll in karate classes.
Chris takes his father's playboy magazine to school, but he soon panics when it's stolen
In celebration of father's day, Julius tells the family he wants to spend the day by himself.
Chris runs into trouble with the law while earning money for a school trip.

Fed up with getting a daily butt kicking from his classmates, Chris asks Julius and Rochelle if he can attend the local middle school instead of Corleone Junior High, but when they say no, Chris tries to get himself expelled.
Hoping to make a better life at Corleone Junior High, Chris his hat in the ring for Class President and asks Greg to be his running mate

Rochelle decides to host a neighborhood watch meeting after Julius' truck is stolen, but her good intentions quickly turn competitive when her new neighbor, Louise thinks she'd make a better block captain than Rochelle.
After failing to make an impression at the town hall meeting, Chris realizes that he needs to deliver the best campaign speech of all time if he's going to win the election for class president.
After Chris accidentally misleads the neighborhood into thinking he and Tasha are dating, Rochelle gets quite an earful from Tasha's grandmother, Louise

Chris is honored when Doc finally entrusts him with watching the cash register, but the situation goes from good to really bad when Chris is robbed by the neighborhood's notorious repeat-offender, Malvo.
Chris's new principal, Principal Edwards decides that the best way to solve the tension between Chris and Caruso is to pair them up as buddies on the school field trip.
After the school newspaper runs several inflammatory stories about Chris and his class presidency, Chris must defend himself against Caruso and his classmates at an impeachment hearing.
After Julius lends Chris a pair of lucky socks, Chris begins to notice that he can do no wrong.
When Julius' successful younger brother joins the family for Thanksgiving, Julius gets in the competitive spirit, determined to make the perfect meal.
Julius and Chris pick up extra work for the holidays, dressing up as Santa Claus and one of his elves to entertain the kids at a local department store.

For a classroom lesson on parenting skills, Chris  and Greg  are each assigned an egg to care for as if it were their own child, but the task proves quite challenging, especially after Chris' mom decides to show him what it really means to be a parent.
A scholarly substitute teacher makes Chris' life a living hell by holding him to a higher standard than his classmates.
When the neighborhood DJ is arrested in the middle of a party, Chris steps in for him and proves to be a huge hit with the crowd.
Hoping to get more respect from his classmates and to stop being Caruso's punching bag, Chris signs up to be a hall monitor.
When Chris accidentally shows up for school on a "snow day," he and Principal Edwards (Alexander) are stuck with each other until they can reach Chris' parents.
When Chris thwarts Malvo's attempt at stealing a gold chain from Vanessa, Malvo gives Chris one day - or suffer the consequences - to produce a replacement necklace.
With their teacher Ms. Morello is out for the day, Chris and Greg decide to cut school and go see the movie "Ghostbusters."
Chris is put in a difficult position when he must choose between going to a baseball game with his dad and Drew and going to the movies with Tasha
Chris becomes Bed- Stuy's favorite odds-maker after Doc discovers he has a natural talent for predicting a game's outcome.

After secretly listening to his parents' comedy albums, tries out some dirty jokes on his classmates and discovers that making people laugh is the key to popularity, but his teacher has a different take on the situation.
With Chris's entire class counting on him to master algebra in time for a math competition, Rochelle takes it upon herself to tutor Chris.
With the end of the school year fast approaching, Chris decides to exact revenge on Caruso to pay him back for making Chris's life miserable for the past two years.
After Chris tests poorly on a standard exam, his teacher, Ms. Morello, refers him to the school's guidance counselor, Mr. Abbott.

Caruso relinquishes his role as school bully after getting bullied himself. However, without Caruso to establish the school's power hierarchy and with everyone vying to fill his shoes, Chris and Greg realize they'd better come up with a fast solution.

Things take a literal turn for the worse when a license-less Chris volunteers to move his dad's car, but finds himself driving the car all the way to school as a result of trying to impress Tasha. Rochelle spends an interesting day at traffic court.
As a result of their apartment being broken into, Julius and Rochelle decide it's a good idea to get a dog, something Chris has always wanted.
